name: unreal, not real
definition: The world, things, or experience seem unreal or lack their normal feeling of reality.

name: dream-like world
definition: The world or life has the quality of being in a dream.

name: simulation or video game
definition: Reality seems like a simulation, virtual reality, or a video game.

name: movie or film
definition: Life or the surrounding scene seems like a movie or film rather than directly lived reality.

name: strange, odd
definition: The world or things seem strange, odd, or peculiar.

name: look unfamiliar
definition: Previously ordinary people, places, or things seem unfamiliar.

name: known but not familiar
definition: Something can still be known or recognized while the felt sense of familiarity is missing.

name: cut off from world
definition: The person feels detached, cut off, or separated from the surrounding world.

name: wall or barrier
definition: An enclosing wall, barrier, screen, or bubble seems to separate the person from the world.

name: detached observer
definition: Experience is watched from the position of an observer, spectator, or third party.

name: outside the body
definition: The experienced point of self-location seems to be outside the physical body.

name: floating, unlocated
definition: The observing self or perspective seems to float or lack a definite location.

name: far away, distant
definition: People, objects, or the world appear unusually far away or distant.

name: flat, two-dimensional
definition: Objects, people, or the world appear flat or two-dimensional.

name: foggy, blurry
definition: Vision or the visible world seems foggy, blurry, hazy, or out of focus.

name: less vivid, dull
definition: Perception seems attenuated, dull, colorless, or lacking its usual vividness.

name: clear, sharp, detailed
definition: Perception seems unusually clear, sharp, acute, bright, or detailed.

name: larger, bigger
definition: Rooms, objects, or the world appear larger than usual.

name: look smaller
definition: Objects or appearances seem smaller than usual or smaller than reality.

name: visually distorted
definition: The visible world, shapes, size, or distance appear distorted.

name: altered colors
definition: Colors or hues appear changed in quality or intensity.

name: spots and dots
definition: The visual field contains spots, dots, or similar small visual marks.

name: overly bright light
definition: Light or light-colored things seem excessively bright or visually overwhelming.

name: time slowed
definition: Time, motion, or events seem to move unusually slowly.

name: time sped up
definition: Time seems to pass unusually fast.

name: time stopped, suspended
definition: Time seems stopped, absent, or suspended in the moment.

name: stretched, eternal time
definition: Brief periods seem stretched out, endless, or eternal.

name: recent feels long ago
definition: Recent events seem remote, as if they happened much longer ago.

name: past feels present
definition: Past events feel present, recently lived, or as though they are being relived.

name: time unreliable, disordered
definition: Time loses its usual reliability, consistency, or clear ordering.

name: time unnoticed, lost
definition: The passage of time is not noticed or seems to be lost altogether.

name: not present or engaged
definition: The person does not feel fully present, immersed, or engaged in the moment or world.

name: world lacks emotional coloring
definition: The world or objects no longer carry their usual personal emotional coloring or resonance.

name: beauty and charm lost
definition: Nature, objects, or surroundings no longer convey their usual beauty, charm, or aesthetic appeal.

name: emotionally distant from others
definition: Other people, including loved ones, feel emotionally distant or disconnected.

name: people as robots
definition: Other people seem robotic, mechanical, programmed, or like automata.

name: people lifeless
definition: Other people seem lifeless, dead, zombie-like, or mannequin-like.

name: people acting, masked
definition: Other people seem to be merely acting, wearing a facade, or producing artificial human-like behavior.

name: people hard to understand
definition: Other people become difficult to understand without deliberate scrutiny or intellectual effort.

name: watched and judged
definition: Other people seem to be watching, scrutinizing, mocking, or judging the person.

name: threatening, unsafe
definition: Other people or the surroundings seem threatening, dangerous, or unsafe.

name: controlled by others
definition: Other people seem to control, direct, or strongly influence one’s thoughts, feelings, or actions.

name: access to others' minds
definition: Other people’s thoughts, feelings, or behavior seem unusually accessible or predictable.

name: oneness with all
definition: The boundary between oneself and everything else seems replaced by a felt oneness with the world or universe.

name: greater concern for others
definition: Other people or humanity evoke unusually strong empathy, concern, or responsibility.

name: blurred self-world boundaries
definition: The boundaries between self and other, self and world, or self and non-self feel blurred or eroded.

name: objects merge with body
definition: Objects seem to merge with, fuse with, or become extensions of the body.

name: virtual body feels mine
definition: A virtual body is experienced as one’s own body or takes over bodily ownership.

name: more real
definition: Things, dreams, or experience can seem unusually or excessively real.

name: doubt in reality
definition: Reality, existence, or common-sense reality is doubted or called into question.

name: known real, feels unreal
definition: Something is still known or believed to be real even though immediate experience does not feel real.

name: imagined or perceived
definition: It becomes unclear whether something was really perceived or instead imagined, thought, or dreamed.

name: real and unreal together
definition: Something can feel real and unreal at the same time, with the boundary between the two suspended.

name: alternate realities
definition: Experience seems to take place in an alternate, parallel, or equally valid reality or world.

name: special meaning, significance
definition: Events, objects, or the universe seem charged with unusual personal meaning or significance.

name: meaningless, irrelevant
definition: Objects, actions, or the world seem meaningless, irrelevant, or without normal value.

name: not directly presented
definition: Objects or the world no longer feel immediately or directly presented to experience.

name: miss the surroundings
definition: Obvious things or ongoing surroundings are not noticed or consciously registered.

name: nothing stands out
definition: Things fail to impose themselves, stand out, or capture and hold attention.

name: absent things perceived
definition: Sounds, images, or things are experienced despite not being currently present.

name: empty, void
definition: The world or landscape seems empty, void-like, or pervaded by nothingness.

name: dead, lifeless world
definition: The world or objects seem dead, deathlike, or lifeless.

name: eerie, uncanny, nightmarish
definition: The world or experience has a frightening, uncanny, eerie, or nightmarish quality.

name: surroundings closing in
definition: The surrounding environment seems to close in, press in, or become suffocating.

name: seen for first time
definition: Familiar things appear as though they are being seen for the first time.

name: shapes and formal details
definition: Things are experienced primarily as shapes, colors, material properties, or formal visual details rather than their ordinary identity.

name: distinctness and differences lost
definition: Objects or things lose their individuality, distinctness, or differences from one another.

name: lack of agency
definition: Events or the world feel beyond one’s control or unaffected by one’s actions.

name: behind everyday appearances
definition: Ordinary appearances seem like a veil or facade behind which a deeper or more real layer can be glimpsed.

name: marveling at existence
definition: The world or existence evokes unusual wonder, mystery, or aesthetic marveling.

name: grotesque, repulsive
definition: Objects or material reality appear grotesque, disgusting, or repulsive.

name: nothing exists
definition: The world, other people, or things seem not merely unreal but nonexistent.

name: more accurate, unfiltered
definition: Perception seems unusually direct, accurate, or free of ordinary filters.
